CAMUNDA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: CIB seven admin/demo user password. If you want to change it, you will have to replace it in the Heroku and the CIB seven dashboard simultaneously.

CIBSEVEN_WEBCLIENT_AUTHENTICATION_JWTSEC.description: At least 155-character base64-decodable JWT secret shared by the CIB seven REST API and webclient.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible provider API key used by the CIB seven AI Agent connector.

CIBSEVEN_CONNECT_AI_AGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Optional deployment-wide default model for CIB seven AI Agent tasks.
